resources.string: We have made some changes since you last logged in. Here are the details:

Version %1$s:
  • Added image translation. After configuring a translation service, switch between the original and translated image, then save or share the result.
  • Choose replies and nested replies to include when sharing a post as an image, with support for long images.
  • Added Weibo group, Friends Circle, and Private Following timelines, post visibility settings, and Live Photo playback. Restored IP location labels.
  • Added global and per-account proxy settings, with HTTPS and SOCKS5 support.
  • Fixed some image-loading failures, gallery bookmark actions, and FANBOX link navigation. Improved mixed timelines, translation display, and remembering account selections.
